name: orchestrator-mode
description: Run a session as an orchestrator: parallel worktree subagents, gated landings (direct or PR-based), fleet monitoring.

interface.shortDescription: Lead a fleet of parallel worktree subagents.
interface.longDescription: Decomposes work into independent tracks, fans them out to parallel subagents in isolated git worktrees with strict file ownership, and gates every landing with reviews, CI watchers, and a fleet monitor, whether tracks push directly onto a mainline or open PRs with per-track bases (independent or stacked).
defaultPrompt: Act as orchestrator and parallelize this plan with worktrees.
Run this multi-track refactor as a subagent fleet.
Orchestrate these independent features in parallel worktrees.
